projects.title: Indigo Sun Florals
projects.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for a local florist with seasonal inventory management, custom arrangement builder, subscription services, and secure checkout. Built iteratively with lessons learned from previous projects.

projects.title: AIDJ Music Library
projects.description: Privacy-focused music library interface integrating with Navidrome for self-hosted streaming. Features comprehensive CI/CD pipeline with security scanning and 80%+ code coverage requirements - reflecting my commitment to code quality learned through trial and error.

projects.title: Minecraft Server List
projects.description: Community-driven server listing platform featuring a transparent multi-factor ranking algorithm, real-time server pinging via minecraft-protocol, voting system with rate limiting, and admin moderation tools. Designed for fairness over paid promotions.

projects.title: Housekeeping Scheduler
projects.description: Purpose-built scheduling tool that replaced error-prone spreadsheet workflows. Features drag-and-drop scheduling, CSV import/export, and real-time sync. Deployed via Docker with Cloudflare Tunnel for secure remote access.

projects.title: Timesheet Calculator
projects.description: Lightweight timesheet management app with automated hour calculations, overtime tracking, and export capabilities. Built to solve a real workplace need with minimal complexity.

projects.title: Financial Planner
projects.description: Comprehensive financial planning application with budgeting tools, investment tracking, and real-time stock data via API integration. Expanding my skills beyond JavaScript into Python and Django.
